global_attrs.title: LandInG v1 land input data
global_attrs.institution: Potsdam Institute for Climate Impact Research (PIK)
global_attrs.summary: Land fraction in each grid cell. Includes inland water bodies. Does not include ocean fraction of cells along coastlines
global_attrs.references: Ostberg et al. (2023) <https://doi.org/10.5194/gmd-16-3375-2023> for LandInG documention; Grid from CRU-TS data, land fractions from GADM version 3.6

history: LandInG toolbox: predefined CRU-TS grid enforced on land fractions extracted from GADM level 0 polygons; post-processing: values >0.999 set to 1
